title: TrustFlow-ECG: Reliability-Aware ECG Restoration with Calibrated Risk Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) restoration models can reduce noise and motion artifacts, but they rarely estimate whether the restored waveform is reliable for downstream analysis. We propose TrustFlow-ECG, a reliability-aware restoration framework that combines a one-step conditional rectified-flow restorer with a lightweight window-level risk predictor. The predictor uses the noisy ECG, restored ECG, and correction residual, then applies validation-set isotonic calibration for selective ECG analysis. We evaluate on MIT-BIH ECG windows corrupted with NSTDB artifacts, powerline interference, and mixed noise across multiple SNRs, with an external 9,675-window PTB-XL stress check without retraining. TrustFlow achieves 0.862 Spearman correlation with true risk and 0.911 AUROC for failure detection, while calibration reduces ECE from 0.0385 to 0.0098. translated_title: TrustFlow-ECG：基于校准风险估计的可靠性感知心电信号恢复
translated_abstract: 心电信号（ECG）恢复模型能够降低噪声和运动伪影，但它们很少评估恢复后的波形对于下游分析是否可靠。我们提出TrustFlow-ECG，一个可靠性感知的心电恢复框架，它将单步条件校正流恢复器与轻量级的窗口级风险预测器相结合。该预测器利用含噪心电信号、恢复后的心电信号以及校正残差，随后应用基于验证集的等保回归校准以实现选择性心电分析。我们在被NSTDB伪影、工频干扰和混合噪声污染、涵盖多种信噪比的MIT-BIH心电窗口上进行评估，并在无需重新训练的情况下对9,675个PTB-XL窗口开展外部压力测试。TrustFlow与真实风险之间的Spearman相关系数达到0.862，失败检测的AUROC达到0.911，同时校准将期望校准误差（ECE）从0.0385降至0.0098。在80%覆盖率下，选择性拒绝将RMSE从0.1848降至0.1345，并将R峰F1（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TrustFlow-ECG提出了一种将单步条件校正流心电恢复与经等保校准的窗口级风险预测相结合的可靠性感知框架，能够量化恢复波形对下游分析的可信度并实现选择性拒绝，从而显著提升风险估计精度与心电分析性能。
en_tdlr: TrustFlow-ECG introduces a reliability-aware ECG restoration framework that couples a one-step conditional rectified-flow restorer with a calibrated window-level risk predictor, enabling selective rejection of unreliable restorations to support trustworthy downstream ECG analysis.
